_README: Everything site-specific, tenant-specific and format-specific lives HERE, not in the .ps1.
Resolution order: built-in defaults  <-  Common  <-  the selected profile.
ANOTHER SITE OR ANOTHER TEAM: add a block under Profiles with that team's values and pick it
in the Profile dropdown (or run with -ProfileName <name>). Anything a team does differently -
the registry key their packages brand themselves with, how their package names are built, the
UAT group naming, and WHICH DEPLOYMENT TOOLKIT they use - is a value in their profile.
Launchers = which file marks a toolkit package and how to install it. If NONE of these is
found, the package is treated as a plain installer: the .intunewin is built from the folder
holding the file SCCM's own install command runs, ServiceUI.exe is copied in beside it, and
SCCM's command lines are reused wrapped in ServiceUI. The tool has no toolkit knowledge of
its own: it looks for Marker in the content, then uses SetupFile / InstallCmd / UninstallCmd.
The shallowest match wins; ties go to whichever is listed first. StageUtilities copies
UtilitiesPath into the package copy (that is how PSADT v3 gets ServiceUI.exe).
A team on a different toolkit adds their own entry - no code change.
UatGroupNamePattern tokens: {Vendor} {AppName} {Arch} {Version} {Revision} {Lang} {FullName}
Every token is reduced to letters and digits, so the name never contains a space or a
special character. The tool NEVER creates the group - the name goes in the report.
PackageNameRegex: optional. Named groups Vendor / AppName / Arch / Version / Revision / Lang.
Leave it empty to use the <Vendor>_<AppName>_<Arch>_<Version>-<Revision>_<Lang> split.
To change the fallback icon, replace Assets\DefaultAppIcon.png - nothing else.
